title.headline: 3,000 agreements a year. Every answer cited.

end.line: Quillon for Halcyon Media Group’s rights team

vo: Halcyon Media's rights team clears about three thousand talent and music agreements a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
Ask one question across a whole matter, and Quillon reads every agreement in the Vault before it answers.
When a producer emails for a clearance under a broadcast deadline, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the clause.
And Vault reviews every agreement at once, so consent and termination rights come back flagged in one table.
Marcus will walk your team through it on Tuesday the twenty-fifth.
